title: Real company name with a lookalike application domain
description: Offer uses legitimate corporate identity (Tata Consultancy Services) but directs applicant to a lookalike domain tcs-careers-portal.example.
unresolved_facts: Ownership of tcs-careers-portal.example is unverified and not linked to Tata Consultancy Services
raw_text:
Tata Consultancy Services Ltd. Reference: TCS/OFFER/2026/0912.
Dear Candidate, we are pleased to offer you the role of Systems Analyst at Tata Consultancy Services.
Package: INR 6,50,000 per annum.
Please confirm your acceptance and submit all onboarding documents exclusively through our official recruitment portal at https://tcs-careers-portal.example/apply within 5 days.
Recruiter: r.verma@tcs-careers-portal.example.

organic_results.title: TCS Careers Portal - Latest Openings
organic_results.snippet: Submit your job applications for TCS vacancies.

rationale: Brand text in a hostname does not establish ownership. This fixture supplies only the claimed lookalike, so canonical ownership remains unresolved; review is required without asserting confirmed impersonation.
